title: Anthropic reportedly signs multiyear cloud deal with IREN: The Information
source_used: Crypto Briefing (relaying The Information); TradingKey read for context only
key_facts: The Information reported that Anthropic has entered into a multiyear cloud-services agreement with IREN.
IREN is a data-centre operator formerly involved in bitcoin mining.
Neither Anthropic nor IREN has confirmed the deal.
IREN had earlier mentioned a contract with an unnamed 'leading frontier AI lab', now believed to be Anthropic.
The deal would put IREN alongside AWS and Google among Anthropic's infrastructure partners as it expands its data centres.
No contract value, size or start date is given in the article.
quote_evidence: Anthropic, the artificial intelligence lab known for its Claude model family, has reportedly entered into a multiyear cloud-services agreement with IREN, a data-center operator formerly involved in bitcoin mining.
This development, reported by The Information, has not yet been confirmed by either company.
IREN had previously mentioned a contract with an unnamed “leading frontier AI lab,” which is now believed to be Anthropic.
why_it_matters_hint: Anthropic adds another computing supplier beyond Amazon and Google as it expands its data centres.
event_date: The Information report, 12 Oct 2026 (relayed by Crypto Briefing the same morning)
